name: OpenAlex
covers: Every indexed scholarly work 2014-2024 grouped by open-access status, by year and by author country; journal records with a converted article processing charge in US dollars
note: CC0, no key, polite pool with a mailto. The oa_status field is the subject of this page rather than its evidence: a work is labelled diamond when its journal is fully open and no author fee is recorded, and 'no fee recorded' is not the same claim as 'no fee'.

name: DOAJ
covers: 23,402 indexed open-access journals with a direct yes/no answer on whether the journal charges an author fee, plus the amount and the currency
note: CC BY-SA, no key. DOAJ asks the journal and records what it says, including the currency. It is the closest thing to a direct answer and it is what the audit on this page compares against.

name: World Bank World Development Indicators
covers: Income group, region and GNI per capita (NY.GNP.PCAP.CD) for each country
note: No key. Used only to describe the countries, never to compute an open-access figure.

name: OpenAlex open-access status documentation
covers: The published definition of the six oa_status values
note: Cited so the gap between the documented definition and the observed behaviour is checkable rather than asserted.
